'''Maize plants''', or corn, are an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|maize flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into <strike> moonshine ethanol </strike>  [[alcohol|maize beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] maize plants for their ''popped kernels''.
